train: pre-2026 eligible episode hours; >=1000 start collateral; no episode fallback; full 24h outcome before 2026
test: 2026 eligible episode hours; no fitting or tuning on holdout
source_policy: exclude any episode with replay Binance fallback from primary fitting/evaluation; fallback-only and all-source sensitivity
budget_method: rank scores, select floor(0.05*N); deterministic pandas row-key hash breaks exact score ties without labels
best_screen: higher holdout recall at matched 5% budget; ties higher precision then act screen; paired bootstrap takes best of both in each replicate

bootstrap.cluster: chain, market, borrower; all episode hours and liquidation events resampled together
bootstrap.operating_point: alerts fixed at original evaluation-set 5% ranking; no classifier refit in resamples

lead_definition: first alert in preceding 24h for each observed liquidation event with an eligible labeled pre-event hour; missed events receive 0h; compare medians over identical event census, and report paired detected-event lead separately
lead_comparator: budget-matched act-line screen; original fixed act-line reported separately
nan_policy: no imputation; observed state and known label required; native HGB missing-feature routing; inf rejected
hour_domain: all hours within non-overlapping eligible Step 2 episodes, not retrieval-screen-selected hours
